instruction: Perimeter Daylighting WWR Model This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio one-story perimeter-and-core daylighting model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json. 1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json with size at least 10 bytes. 2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 5 OS:Space objects, and 5 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly North Perimeter, South Perimeter, East Perimeter, West Perimeter, and Core. 5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 30 OS:Surface objects: 5 Floor surfaces, 5 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 20 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 5 Ground, 17 Outdoors, and 8 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 12 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 12. 9. The model contains exactly 5 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 5 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, 5 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects, and 2 OS:Daylighting:Control objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 24.00 m, Y span 24.00 m, and Z span 3.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 512.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 288.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 100.80 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 14. /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json contains zone_count, daylighting_control_count, south_wwr, west_wwr, north_wwr, and east_wwr values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%). Any item not explicitly required may vary.
